remediation: DEFECT 1 (blocking) - archived função read as unset. Root cause was that the per-row escape hatch `funcao.id === row.funcaoId` ran INSIDE the already-active-filtered `eligibleFuncoes`, so an archived função was absent from the option list entirely and, with no valueLabel, the trigger fell back to the placeholder. Fixed by splitting the two concerns: `eligibleFuncoes` (active, non-system) is now only the pool a NEW row draws from, while `costRowFuncaoOptions(row)` resolves the row's own stored value against the UNFILTERED `funcoes` and prepends it when the eligible list excludes it - the same shape as `selectableAreas` in this very dialog, and the rule CLAUDE.md already documents for the pessoa assignment picker. `funcaoCostOptionLabel` marks an archived one ' (arquivada)' so the operator can tell it is no longer assignable, and `valueLabel={costRowFuncaoValueLabel(row)}` was added as the coordinator asked. I found a SECOND symptom of the same defect while testing: `allFuncoesUsed` compared `usedFuncaoIds.size` against `eligibleFuncoes.length`, so a row carrying an archived função consumed a slot in a pool it is not in and wrongly DISABLED `Adicionar` while an assignable função was still free - it is now `usedEligibleCount`, counted against the eligible pool only. RED CONFIRMED: I copied the fixed file aside, `git stash push` reverted SalesOpsApp.tsx to committed ec2b364, and against that code 'keeps naming an archived função on the cost row that already carries it' and 'never offers an archived função to a row that does not already carry it' both FAILED (2 failed / 34 passed) - the first on the trigger reading the placeholder, the second on 'combobox not found: Função do custo padrão 2' because Adicionar was disabled, which is how the second symptom surfaced. `git stash pop` then `diff -q` confirmed the implementation was restored byte-identical. Note on the fix I chose: the coordinator suggested valueLabel as the mechanism, but valueLabel alone only repairs the DISPLAY and leaves the value unrestorable (the verifier's own second bullet), so admitting the função into the row's options is the load-bearing half. That made valueLabel dead code on the archived path, and shipping an unfalsifiable prop is exactly what Gate 2 penalises, so I gave it a reachable job instead: a stored funcaoId that resolves to nothing at all now reads 'Função não encontrada' rather than the placeholder, and never the raw uuid. Three tests cover it (archived-and-carried, archived-and-not-offered, unresolvable-id), and every one of the four mechanisms is independently mutation-checked. || DEFECT 2 - unpinned submit clamp. Added 'clamps a hand-typed parcela count to the ceiling at submit' (types 500 with no entrada, asserts the payload carries 120; then 500 WITH a fixed entrada, asserts 119) and 'floors a hand-typed parcela count at one' (types 0, asserts 1). These reach submit with an out-of-range value, which the existing cap test never did because it arrived at 119 through the setEntradaMode clamp. INVERSION CONFIRMED: the verifier's exact mutation - deleting `Math.min(parcelasCeiling, ...)` from submit() - now goes RED, as does deleting the `Math.max(1, ...)` floor separately. || DEFECT 3 - formatting drift. Confirmed the diagnosis and that my own check was invalid: prettier is not installed in this repo (`pnpm exec prettier` fails), so my first measurement silently produced empty output; `pnpm dlx prettier@3` (3.9.6) reproduced the verifier's baseline exactly, master prettier_deltas=492 non_ws=438. `git diff -w` was indeed the wrong instrument - it has no counterpart for an added line, so it cannot check one's indentation. Fixed by taking prettier's indentation for MY lines only: derive the added/changed line set from SequenceMatcher(master, current) insert+replace opcodes, align current against prettier's output by STRIPPED content, and adopt prettier's leading whitespace only where the line is mine AND the two differ by whitespace alone - so no pre-existing line is reformatted and no non-whitespace byte moves. 333 lines re-indented, converging on a second pass. Whitespace-only prettier deltas attributable to my added lines went 413 -> 0 (measured directly, not via git diff -w). The 72 pre-existing lines whose indentation this branch still changes are the Módulos ListEditor, which is genuinely +2 now that it sits inside `{isService ? null : (...)}`, and prettier agrees with that new depth; one further apparent hit at L3775 is a difflib mis-pairing of a bare `` and was verified correct in context. Concretely, every example the verifier cited is fixed: `type FuncaoCostForm` is back at module scope indent 0, `kind: SalesOpsProductKind;` at 2 alongside its siblings, the `funcaoCosts=` / `funcoes=` JSX props at 6 alongside `areas=`, `const parcelas` at 4 beside `event.preventDefault()`, and setKind/setEntradaMode/setCostRow closing at 2. || VERIFICATION: all four gates re-run green - lint=0 type-check=0 test=0 build=0, web 34 files / 288 tests (+5 over attempt 1), api 27/283 and shared-utils 1/17 both unchanged. 18 mutations re-run AFTER the re-indent (7 remediation + 11 regression spot-checks of the original set, whose match strings had to be re-derived because indentation moved): 18 RED, 0 survived.
